tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground. Warm off-white in light, near-black graphite in dark. Body, header and footer all sit on it.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on `background`, `card` and `popover` (15.8:1 light, 14.7:1 dark). Also the current nav item.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Slightly raised surface for contained blocks. Pair with `card-foreground`.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card` (15.1:1 light, 13.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces (menus, popovers). Same as `background` in light, as `card` in dark.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The teal accent. Link text, the emphasised word in a headline, ArticleRow title hover, blockquote rule and the default Button fill. Reads 6.2:1 (light) and 10.4:1 (dark) on `background`, 5.5:1 / 8.9:1 on `muted`.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `primary` fill: light ink in light, dark ink in dark because the dark teal is pale (6.2:1 / 10.4:1).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Fill for the secondary Button variant.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary` (11.5:1 light, 12.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: inline code chips, table header cells, ghost/outline Button hover.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, mono meta lines, section labels, inactive nav, footer, blockquotes. 7.1:1 / 7.5:1 on `background`, 6.3:1 / 6.5:1 on `muted`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Teal-tinted wash. Text selection background; use sparingly for a highlighted surface.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`, including selected text (11.0:1 light, 9.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors and the destructive Button variant (text on a 10–20% tint of itself). 5.1:1 / 5.4:1 on `background`. Always pair with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `destructive` fill.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: The default hairline: header and footer rules, section-label underline, list dividers, tables, code blocks, image frames. It is decorative (about 1.4:1), so it never marks a control's edge by itself.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Form-field borders and the dark outline Button border. Same value as `border`.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline: 2px solid, offset 2px, on every focusable element. Equals `primary`, so it is at least 5.9:1 on every surface.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Home hero headline only (36px below 640px). Italicise the last word in `primary`.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One h1 per page, via PageHeader. Balance-wrapped.

styles.name: article-h2
styles.usage: h2 inside article body. 40px space above, 16px below.

styles.name: article-row-title
styles.usage: Article titles in lists. Turns `primary` on hover.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The site name in the header. This is the brand's text logo.

styles.name: blockquote
styles.sample: Treat context as infrastructure, not a longer prompt.
styles.usage: Pull quotes in articles, in `muted-foreground` with a 3px `primary` left rule.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: I ship web apps and write for AI builders and operators.
styles.usage: Intro paragraphs and PageHeader descriptions, in `muted-foreground`.

styles.name: article-body
styles.sample: Small demos and how they work. Agents in real shipping.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A short description under an article title.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Nav links, key/value rows, footer, secondary links.

styles.name: code-block
styles.sample: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy
styles.usage: Shiki code blocks. Inline code is 0.875em on a `muted` chip.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Dates, tags, footer links, RSS, in `muted-foreground`. Separate items with ' · '.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Uppercase section headings above lists, with a `border` underline and 12px padding below.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase byline under the home headline.

spacing.note: Tailwind's 4px scale. These are the steps the site actually uses.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight inline gaps (Button icon gap is 6px; title-to-description gap in ArticleRow is 6px).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Meta line under an article description; small inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Header vertical padding; section-label padding under its text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap from a section label to its list; gap between header items.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Vertical padding on each ArticleRow; gap between contact links.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page side gutter; footer vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space under a PageHeader.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Main content vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Gap between home page sections.

radius.note: From one base, `--radius: 0.375rem`. Corners are small; the site is mostly rules and type.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code chips; ArticleRow focus outline.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Skip link; small Buttons (xs, sm).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The base radius: Buttons, code blocks, article images, the portrait.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Larger contained surfaces, rarely used.

layout.note: Fixed measures from the page shell.

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: Max width of header, main and footer (Tailwind max-w-2xl). One reading column, no sidebars.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every nav, contact and text link (min-h-11).

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Default Button height. sm 28px, lg 36px; the theme toggle is 40px square.

tokens.name: focus-ring-width
tokens.usage: Focus outline width, offset 2px, in `ring`.
